extracted.name: Bavarian Style Meatballs
extracted.description: Cranberry sauce, chili sauce, sauerkraut, and meatballs team up in the slow cooker for a sweet and sour party appetizer that's easy to make.
instruction_lines: Mix sauerkraut, cranberry sauce, chili sauce, water, and brown sugar together in a mixing bowl until well combined.

Place meatballs into a slow cooker. Pour in sauce and mix until meatballs are coated. Cover and cook on Medium, stirring occasionally, until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reads at least 160 degrees F (71 degrees C), about 4 hours.
